This clause should be changed to soft. Additionally, the hard clauses provided (Existence(door_open) and Precedence(has_key, door_open)) make has_key a redundant forced event for the hard part of the task, but as the goal is soft, the primary hard requirement is simply 'open the door' (which implicitly requires the key due to the Precedence). The error is the priority of the Precedence(door_open, at_goal) clause.

Remove the Existence(has_key) clause; keep Existence(door_open) and Precedence(has_key, door_open).
